title: Pita aur beti ki umar

authoring.author: Parikshaa content team
authoring.originality: Written for Parikshaa: own numbers, story and explanation; no text from any question bank.

stem: Aaj Rakesh ki umar apni beti Pooja ki umar ki 4 guna hai. 6 saal baad wo Pooja ki umar ka 2.5 guna hoga. Aaj Pooja kitne saal ki hai?
explanation:
### Samjho
Do baatein di hain: aaj ka rishta (4 guna) aur 6 saal baad ka (2.5 guna). Poocha hai Pooja ki **aaj** ki umar.

### Plan
Pooja ki aaj ki umar x maano; Rakesh 4x. 6 saal baad dono me 6 judega. Ek equation banegi.

### Hal
1. 6 saal baad: Rakesh 4x + 6, Pooja x + 6.
2. 4x + 6 = 2.5 (x + 6) = 2.5x + 15.
3. 4x − 2.5x = 15 − 6, yaani 1.5x = 9.
4. x = 9 ÷ 1.5 = **6 saal**.

### Jaancho
Aaj: Pooja 6, Rakesh 24 (4 guna ✓). 6 saal baad: 12 aur 30, aur 30 = 2.5 × 12 ✓. 9 saal wo number hai jo 1.5x = 9 me dikhta hai (x nahi); 12 saal Pooja ki 6 saal **baad** ki umar hai; 24 saal Rakesh ki aaj ki umar hai.

distractors.mistake: 1.5x = 9 me 9 ko hi x maan liya
Pooja ki 6 saal baad ki umar di, aaj ki nahi
Rakesh ki umar di, Pooja ki nahi

revision_card.back: Aaj ki umar x maano, dono rishton se ek equation, phir dono shartein jaancho.
